title: BTS Star RM Shows His Art Collection at a Museum
summary:
RM, the leader of the K-pop band BTS, is sharing art from his own collection at a museum for the first time. The San Francisco Museum of Modern Art is packed with fans who want to see it.

The show has more than 170 artworks. Most belong to RM, and many are by Korean artists. The museum's gift shop got ready with more souvenirs than ever before.

RM, whose real name is Kim Nam-joon, is 32. He started visiting museums and collecting art nearly 10 years ago. Some of his songs were inspired by art. Fans even made up a word, "Namjooning," for doing the things he loves.

RM said he picked art that really moved him and still has something to say today.

Two fans, Bre Walker and Joi Karra, spotted seven carved wooden ducks and wondered if they stood for the seven members of BTS. Walker said it was her first time ever in an art museum. "I'll be back," she said.
why_it_matters: It shows that a favorite singer can inspire fans to try new things, like visiting an art museum.
